name: Card
say: the piece alone on a quiet ground, the size it would be in a real product

name: In place
say: a cropped slice of the screen or page the piece belongs to, with quiet neighbours

name: Whole screen
say: the piece fills the page edge to edge, its main number or title very large

name: Instrument
say: a measuring instrument's face: a bezel, scales and ticks

name: Cut paper
say: layers of cut paper in tints of the palette, each a little above the last

name: Glass
say: glass panels over the person's photo, or over a map or the subject's own words drawn large, after Apple's Liquid Glass

name: Scene
say: a reel set in a drawn place from its subject

name: System
say: as it would ship in an iPhone app: the system face, capsule controls, grouped surfaces

name: Editorial
say: for an article or a report: the chart as a captioned figure in a page of copy

name: Split
say: for a presentation: the takeaway in one large line beside the chart

name: Stationery
say: for subjects made of paper: the piece printed on the ticket, menu, receipt or label itself
